title: Convert a NSW Senior Savers Card to a NSW Seniors Card
summary: Learn how to convert your NSW Senior Savers Card to a NSW Seniors Card if you have reduced your paid employment or retired.
intro:
If you reduce your paid employment to 20 hours a week or less (averaged over 12 months), or you retire completely, you can convert your NSW Senior Savers Card to a NSW Seniors Card.

You can do this online, or by calling 13 77 88 or visiting a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: Not working at all or averaging 20 hours or less of paid work across a 12-month period
what_you_need: The 'Seniors/Senior Savers Card' service added to your MyServiceNSW Account

how_to_steps.text: Check you meet the eligibility requirements.
Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to convert your card.

more_info.text: If you wish, you can get a digital version of the Seniors/Senior Savers Card through the Service NSW app.

faqs.q: How can I convert my NSW Senior Savers Card?
faqs.a: You can convert your card online, by calling 13 77 88, or by visiting a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to convert their card?
faqs.a: You must be aged 60 or over, live in NSW, be an Australian citizen or permanent resident, and either not be working or average 20 hours or less of paid work over a 12-month period.

faqs.q: What do I need to convert my card online?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, the 'Seniors/Senior Savers Card' service added to your account, your personal details, and your Senior Savers Card number.
